adjudication.rationale: In `EmbeddableHost`, `before_validation` strips scheme and path but leaves any `:port` intact (`self.host.sub!(/^https?:\/\//,''); self.host.sub!(/\/.*$/,'')`), and the validation regex explicitly allows a port. adjudication.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/store.js.es6`, the new plural-handling branch in `_hydrateEmbedded` does `obj[k].map(...)` whenever the key matches `/(.+)_id(s?)$/` and `m[2]` is truthy. Since the new admin UI saves through this model, such hosts cannot be created/updated anymore, whereas the prior `SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts` approach had no comparable validation and could allow these values.

adjudication.rationale: The diff clearly changes unauthenticated embed access checks to hit the DB: EmbedController#ensure_embeddable and TopicRetriever#invalid_host? now call EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?(request.referer/@embed_url), which calls EmbeddableHost.record_for_host and executes `where("lower(host) = ?", host).first` each time. adjudication_records.issue_text: Delete failure is silent in app/assets/javascripts/admin/components/embeddable-host.js.es6:48-54: destroyRecord().then(...) lacks a .catch(popupAjaxError) unlike save(), so a failed delete leaves the row in place with no feedback and an unhandled rejection

adjudication.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/admin/components/embeddable-host.js.es6`, the `delete()` action calls `this.get('host').destroyRecord().then(...)` without any `.catch(...)`, while `save()` does `...catch(popupAjaxError)`. If the DELETE request fails, the promise rejection is unhandled and there is no user-visible error; additionally, `deleteHost` is only sent on success so the row remains with no feedback. This is directly verifiable in the diff (lines ~48-54 of the new file).

adjudication_records.issue_text: Fabricator files are swapped: spec/fabricators/category_fabricator.rb defines :embeddable_host and spec/fabricators/embeddable_host_fabricator.rb defines the category fabricators; it only works because both files are loaded wholesale and will confuse future editors

adjudication.rationale: The diff shows `spec/fabricators/category_fabricator.rb` was changed to define `Fabricator(:embeddable_host)` (and no longer defines the category-related fabricators), while the new file `spec/fabricators/embeddable_host_fabricator.rb` contains the `Fabricator(:category)` and related category variants. This mismatch is real and would be confusing/fragile for future editors, even if Fabrication loads all fabricator files so tests may still pass.

adjudication_records.issue_text: expandable_first_post? at app/models/topic.rb:869 now only checks embed_truncate? && has_topic_embed?, so sites with zero EmbeddableHost rows but embed_truncate enabled still get expandable-first-post behavior on embedded topics, a behavioral regression from the previous gating on hosts being configured

adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `Topic#expandable_first_post?` from `SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts.present? && SiteSetting.embed_truncate? && has_topic_embed?` to only `SiteSetting.embed_truncate? && has_topic_embed?` (app/models/topic.rb). Since `embeddable_hosts` site setting is removed and there is no replacement check like `EmbeddableHost.exists?`, the method can return true even when there are zero `EmbeddableHost` rows, as long as `embed_truncate` is enabled and the topic has a `TopicEmbed` record. That’s a verifiable behavioral change/regression in the gating condition introduced by this diff.

adjudication_records.issue_text: Admin::EmbeddingController#update is a no-op that just re-renders and the client saveChanges() calls embedding.update({}), a latent silent-pass mechanism: if a save button is added later, the UI would report success while persisting nothing

adjudication.rationale: In the diff, `Admin::EmbeddingController#update` (app/controllers/admin/embedding_controller.rb) does not apply any params or persist anything; it simply re-serializes `@embedding` (an `OpenStruct` built in `fetch_embedding`) the same way `#show` does. On the client, `saveChanges()` in `app/assets/javascripts/admin/controllers/admin-embedding.js.es6` calls `this.get('embedding').update({})`, which will issue a PUT to `/admin/customize/embedding` (via the new adapter). There is currently no save button wired to `saveChanges` in `embedding.hbs`, and the actual persistence happens per-host via `EmbeddableHost#save`, so this is not a user-visible broken flow today, but it is a real, diff-grounded “no-op update endpoint + client action” mismatch that could silently appear successful if later connected to UI/API expectations.
